reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Zach Bucknoff
reviews.text: Great experience with Bryan and the team at JB Autobody. They did great work, finished the job quickly, and at a solid price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Madi Duffy
reviews.text: Highly recommend this shop! Bryan is extremely helpful, communicative, and extremely reasonably priced. I’ll absolutely be back any time I need auto body work.

reviews.author: Marc DeDonato
reviews.text: Bryan and his crew were amazing. They got what was a pretty complex job done quickly and well. Bryan was easy to get in touch with if I had questions and I can't reccomend them enough. Go to JB AutoBody if you need auto body work!

reviews.author: Tatiana Marín
reviews.text: I had a huge damage in the doors of the car. They did an amazing job and most important: on time! They had it ready super fast. Also, they have an amazing customer service. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: frank henderson
reviews.text: J&B definitely is the place to go when needing any auto body issues addressed, from jobs small to big. Even when my door wouldn’t close and I didn’t have insurance I pulled up and they fixed my issue within 15 mins. They not just an auto body shop they are a staple in the community. Ty J&B auto

reviews.author: Sara Castro
reviews.text: My husband took his car 2 years ago to get full painted, they did a great job. And the price was reasonable. Now I took my to get some work done and the price Mr Antonio gave me is reasonable again. I will recommend you to go to him.

reviews.author: Jacob Cash
reviews.text: I took a Silver ML350 Mercedes there to get touched up in a few areas. They did a really nice job blending everything in. It looked like a factory job. I was impressed by their level of Service as well. They met with me on time, provided clear expectations on when the vehicle would be done, and they finished on time. They also treated me well on the price. I was happy. Job well done and I'd highly recommend them to anyone else.

reviews.author: Cindy Chen
reviews.text: They did a great job with the repair at a far better price than the other shops in the area. The owner honored the price he gave when I had to go home and think about it for a few days. This place only takes cash though. They really went above and beyond and I will definitely come back here for any future repairs.

reviews.author: Clarence Romero
reviews.text: My BMW came out looking like nothing happened, they even buffed out scratches around my vehicle. The best price and service. They are small but deliver excellent service at a fair price.

reviews.author: sushanth kamath
reviews.text: Antonio and his crew really know their craft. Got a collision repair work done from these guys, and they did a splendid job. Couldn’t tell that there was any collision at all, paint job was really well done too. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Victoria Tarantino
reviews.text: This is a GREAT, family-owned and run business. Antonio is the owner and his beautiful wife, Thelma, are wonderful people. Professional, courteous and HONEST. His body work is true and true. I've recommended his collision so to many other satisfied customers from all over the county and state.

reviews.author: Andrew Bacha
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with J&B, fast, very reasonably priced and they went above and beyond what they needed to do. In a day and age where everything is a ripoff and a scam it was so refreshing to have had such a great experience here. I can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: David Small
reviews.text: Our Volvo looked like new after their handiwork. We couldn't thank them enough for the great job at a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Jon Davidoff
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job. You can tell when an owner takes pride in their work and it shows. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: alexander contreras
reviews.text: horrible experience, they will keep your car parked outside collecting tickets while they move very slow in doing a sloppy job. do not come here you will end up paying more than you bargained for.

reviews.author: Siorsiny Valdez
reviews.text: Don't go often thank God but when I do cars come out like nothing ever happened for a good price too.

reviews.author: Jaylin D.
reviews.text: They did a quick and amazing job on my car right after an accident. I had pretty bad damage to my front bumper, which was causing it to hang off. Bryan was very helpful and kind during this tough time. Thank you for all your hard work guys! (It’s not letting me upload photos, but it is as good as new.)

reviews.author: ramon gonzalez
reviews.text: I didn't like the work they did; it was poor quality, they weren't meticulous in terms of finishing, and it only took two months.

reviews.author: Xiomara Daniela Cedeño
reviews.text: I absolutely do NOT recommend this place. This is the only place I've ever taken my car for repairs. After two months, I went back because the headlight he fixed was misaligned and the light was no longer working. He told me to leave the car for repairs, and I left it for two whole days thinking he was going to fix it. When I returned to pick up my car, he told me the headlight was no longer under warranty and that he wasn't going to repair it. The man knew from the beginning that the headlight was out of warranty, and he still left me without a car for two days just to tell me he wasn't going to fix it. I spent money on Ubers to get to work, and he was so inconsiderate that he even told me I had to go to Mazda to complain about the headlight, even though he knows the headlight has nothing to do with Mazda, and he didn't do a good job from the start. He asked me why I hadn't gone sooner, and I explained that I was traveling… even so, he told me he wasn't going to fix it… I still have the receipt for the $3,000 I paid to have my vehicle repaired after I was hit, and they still left the light and the bulb completely crooked and poorly installed.

reviews.author: Mainor Cardona
reviews.text: 5 stars for this place! I received a fair price for excellent work; they exceeded my expectations. I recommend them without hesitation.
